purpose: Regression verification matrix — what to test after each cleanup wave

identity: Sign-in for all active users post-wave
mail: Inbound delivery to all public-facing mailboxes
collaboration: Teams channel access for active teams
SharePoint site access for document owners
automation: Power Automate flows trigger and complete successfully
web: App Service (HOST-02) responds and serves correct content
GitHub Actions workflows complete without credential failure
One intake form routes to correct destination

Wave 4 mailbox: Test email to each changed mailbox from external address
Confirm Bookings still sends confirmations if mailbox is used by Bookings
Wave 5 teams: Confirm voicemail delivery to voicemail@jmerrill.pub if Voicemail Team decoupled
Confirm no active meeting or channel in archived Teams
Confirm SharePoint site for archived Team is still readable
Wave 6 sharepoint: Confirm foundation_comm content accessible in foundation_div if migrated
Confirm no Power Automate flows broke after projects cleanup
Confirm no GitHub Action broke after projects cleanup

success_criteria: Functional test passes for each applicable domain, not merely that the admin command returned success
